concept: 1978 VHS ritual in the language of The Holy Mountain: nine women in white kneel in symmetry before a faceless heart of raw flesh in a white cave, liquid gold runs down the altar steps; the painted 117 sits mostly above frame (its three blood drips hang at the top), so 117 is NOT fully readable in this one
audio_source: original sound made locally: synthesized organ, bells and noise with Windows text-to-speech voices; no third-party audio
